avis.titre: Great product for dry lips when nothing else works
avis.texte: Great instant relief for exceptionally dry lips. I bought this after trying some of my sisters and I didn't regret it. I had extremely dry lips that couldn't be remedied with the usual lip balm or vaseline and nothing seemed to help. I'm not sure if its a perimenopause symptom but I had never experienced this dryness before. So I tried this SOS lip repair and it instantly made my lips feel better. You only need a small amount, its quite thick and provides a layer or barrier on your lips. It really is worth the price if nothing else is working, I now carry this in my handbag where ever I go.
